observations.body: Inherited credentials are counted loss for knowing Christ. Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe. if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

payload.posture: Read Philippians 3:1–11 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states inherited credentials are counted loss for knowing Christ. Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe. if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
